issue.title: Pause in-flight downloads when transport becomes blocked
issue.body:
## Summary

The Wi-Fi / cellular transport gate currently applies to download **start**, **resume**, and queue auto-resume only. Turning off **Upload/Download over cellular** or losing Wi-Fi does **not** pause a download that is already running.

This is the follow-up called out on [#546](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/546) / PR #559.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An in-flight download pauses (or otherwise stops transferring) when the shared transport policy is no longer `ok` (cellular + toggle off, or no link).
- [ ] Upload in-flight behavior is explicit (pause vs finish current chapter) and matches the same policy unless waived.
- [ ] UI explains why the transfer stopped.

## Out of scope

Unifying start/resume gating (done in #546).

comments.body: Closed: opened from a review nit, not requested. Mid-download gating remains a note in PR #559 Follow-ups without a ticket.
